about: Selwyn Township is a rural municipality in Peterborough County, Ontario, north of Peterborough toward Bridgenorth, Lakefield approaches, and Chemong Lake. Cottage lakes, villages, and farmland share the Kawartha edge rather than forming a continuous city. County roads link shoreline communities into Peterborough. About 19,000 people live in Selwyn Township.
seoSummary: Peterborough County township of Bridgenorth and Chemong Lake—Kawartha villages and cottage shore, not a city.
